It also alternates between terse generic answers and off-scope elaboration, with weaker named detail than references in some factual/expository tasks. Safety behavior is less stable: it can be over-permissive about informal authorization, give more concrete harmful chemical detail, mishandle self-harm tone, or use inappropriate whimsical framing for hazards. Overall this looks like a distinct model/run behavior beyond ordinary seed variation.

It also follows exact wording/exclusion constraints less reliably. On factual, multilingual, and cultural prompts it more often supplies confident but unsupported specifics—dates, laws, percentages, named events, institutions, etymologies, awards—or answers in the wrong frame. In some sensitive/legal/health-adjacent contexts it adds more concrete operational details while still caveating or refusing. Overall it appears more verbose, scaffold-heavy, and hallucination-prone than the reference fine-tunes.
